summary: States requirements for a mechanism that identifies which name server instance answered a DNS query. With anycast and load balancing, many servers can share one address, making it hard to tell which one replied. A standard way to find out would help administrators with diagnostics. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Many helpers answer the same phone number. When something goes wrong, you want to know which helper picked up. This note says what a way to ask them should look like.

questions: how to tell which dns server answered
identify a dns name server instance
